convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Volume_Weighted_MACandle indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trading operations (open/close positions, money management, new bar detection). Custom indicator buffer logic cannot be auto-converted without re-implementing the indicator.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: BuyPosClose/SellPosClose enabled via input booleans; close opposite side when signal reverses (Col[1]==2 triggers SELL_Close, Col[1]==0 triggers BUY_Close)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT (fixed lot) and percent-based margin allocation; MM=0.1 is interpreted differently depending on MMMode

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads buffer index 4 from the custom Volume_Weighted_MACandle indicator. Buffer values are categorical (0=bearish, 2=bulllish). Entry logic: Col[1]==2 AND Col[0]<2 triggers BUY (color changed to bullish on previous bar, current bar not yet confirmed bullish). Col[1]==0 AND Col[0]>0 triggers SELL (color changed to bearish). Signal is evaluated only on new bars (IsNewBar guard) or when SignalBar==0 (every tick). Signal time is set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec (i.e., the open time of the next bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as master switches for each trade direction.
python_conversion_notes: Must re-implement the Volume_Weighted_MACandle custom indicator logic (buffer 4 = candle color state: 0=bearish, 2=bulllish). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory - all need Python equivalents. The margin mode LOT vs percent-based sizing must be handled. Signal logic uses 2-bar lookback on buffer 4 (SignalBar and SignalBar+1). No digit adjustment is performed on SL/TP values - they are passed directly in points.
